about_the_game:
Phantom City Mist is a PRG role-playing game where players take on the role of a young man who has just entered the martial arts world. They explore the open world, find an NPC at a designated location, and solve the main storyline step by step. The goal is to unlock all maps and storylines.

The game plot is a distinctive feature of this work. The development team has conceived a story of a hero and turned the scenes in the story into a game map, allowing players to have a more immersive experience

Main storyline: Players explore different maps, find designated NPCs for dialogue, and connect the protagonist's story to experience the thrilling plot

Open World: Explore every corner of the map, find hidden treasure chests, and even encounter terrifying monsters. Defeat them to escape! (The combat mode adopts turn based mode)

Game duration: Approximately 5 hours

Game Features: Narrative PRG Game

Game Engine: prgmaker mv

Game map: City of Illusion, Fishing Village, Ghost Valley, Demon Realm Blood Pool, Demon Realm, Coast

Follow up plan: Introduce more maps and multi ending storylines, and of course, developers will also carefully listen to players' opinions
